{{Top|leg}}
The '''Calamar Power Plant''' was the primary energy provider to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Calamar]] on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the plant was shut down by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel agents]] as a diversion to escape capture. The resulting blackout threw the city into chaos.
